req.title: Task id is auto-generated
req.statement: The system shall assign a unique integer id to each new task; client-supplied ids in the payload shall be ignored.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-030 requires that (1) every POST /tasks/ response carries a server-assigned integer id, (2) two successive creates receive distinct ids, and (3) any id field supplied by the client in the request body is silently ignored and overwritten by the server. Tests cover: positive EP (normal create returns integer id), positive STC (two creates yield distinct, monotonically increasing ids), boundary BVA (client supplies id=1 which already exists in pre-loaded data — server must still assign a new unique id and ignore the supplied value), negative NEG (missing required title field yields 422), negative NEG (title exceeds max length yields 422), boundary BVA (description at exactly 500 chars is accepted and id is still auto-generated), and DT (client supplies both id and all other fields — only non-id fields are persisted, id is overridden). Each test imports the app in-process, uses TestClient, and asserts exact status codes and field types/values to maximise mutation kill rate.

tests.name: test_create_task_returns_auto_generated_integer_id
preconditions: Database contains 20 pre-loaded tasks with ids 1-20
actions: POST /tasks/ with valid payload {title, description, completed}
Inspect response status code and body
expected: Response body contains field 'id' of type int
id is not equal to any value supplied in the request (none supplied)
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_create_task_returns_auto_generated_integer_id():
    payload = {"title": "Buy groceries", "description": "A", "completed": True}
    r = client.post("/tasks/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert "id" in body
    assert isinstance(body["id"], int)
    assert body["id"] > 0
    assert body["title"] == "Buy groceries"
    assert body["description"] == "A"
    assert body["completed"] is True
    assert "created_at" in body

tests.name: test_two_consecutive_creates_receive_distinct_ids
expected: The two ids are not equal to each other
Second id is greater than first id (auto-increment)
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_two_consecutive_creates_receive_distinct_ids():
    p1 = {"title": "Write project report", "completed": False}
    p2 = {"title": "Schedule dentist appointment", "completed": True}
    r1 = client.post("/tasks/", json=p1)
    r2 = client.post("/tasks/", json=p2)
    assert r1.status_code == 201
    assert r2.status_code == 201
    id1 = r1.json()["id"]
    id2 = r2.json()["id"]
    assert isinstance(id1, int)
    assert isinstance(id2, int)
    assert id1 > 0
    assert id2 > 0
    assert id1 != id2
    assert id2 > id1

tests.name: test_client_supplied_id_is_ignored
preconditions: Database contains 20 pre-loaded tasks with ids 1-20
Client sends a payload that includes an 'id' field set to 1 (already exists)
actions: POST /tasks/ with payload containing id=1 plus valid title/completed
expected: Returned id is a positive integer
Returned id is NOT 1 (the client-supplied value was ignored)
Returned id is greater than 20 (new auto-assigned id beyond pre-loaded rows)
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_client_supplied_id_is_ignored():
    payload = {"id": 1, "title": "Clean the kitchen", "description": "A", "completed": False}
    r = client.post("/tasks/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert isinstance(body["id"], int)
    assert body["id"] != 1
